devanagari: ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥
phonetic: Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah Tat Savitur Varenyam Bhargo Devasya Dhimahi Dhiyo Yo Nah Prachodayat.
english_text: We meditate upon the adorable radiance of Savitr, the divine source. May that light illumine and guide our understanding.

devanagari: ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् । उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान् मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतात् ॥
phonetic: Om Tryambakam Yajamahe Sugandhim Pushtivardhanam Urvarukamiva Bandhanan Mrityor Mukshiya Maamritat.
english_text: We worship the Three-Eyed Lord who nourishes all beings. May He liberate us from death while leading us toward immortality.

devanagari: वक्रतुण्ड महाकाय सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभ । निर्विघ्नं कुरु मे देव सर्वकार्येषु सर्वदा ॥
phonetic: Vakratunda Mahakaya Suryakoti Samaprabha Nirvighnam Kuru Me Deva Sarva Karyeshu Sarvada.
english_text: O Ganesha, mighty and radiant like millions of suns, remove obstacles from all my undertakings, always.

devanagari: असतो मा सद्गमय । तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय । मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय । ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
phonetic: Asato Ma Sadgamaya Tamaso Ma Jyotir Gamaya Mrityor Ma Amritam Gamaya Om Shantih Shantih Shantih.
english_text: Lead me from the unreal to the Real, from darkness to light, and from mortality to immortality. Om, peace, peace, peace.

devanagari: सरस्वति नमस्तुभ्यं वरदे कामरूपिणि । विद्यारम्भं करिष्यामि सिद्धिर्भवतु मे सदा ॥
phonetic: Saraswati Namastubhyam Varade Kamarupini Vidyarambham Karishyami Siddhir Bhavatu Me Sada.
english_text: O Saraswati, giver of blessings, I bow to You as I begin my studies. May there always be success in my learning.

devanagari: सर्वे भवन्तु सुखिनः । सर्वे सन्तु निरामयाः । सर्वे भद्राणि पश्यन्तु । मा कश्चिद्दुःखभाग्भवेत् ॥
phonetic: Sarve Bhavantu Sukhinah Sarve Santu Niramayah Sarve Bhadrani Pashyantu Ma Kashchid Duhkhabhag Bhavet.
english_text: May all be happy; may all be free from illness; may all see what is auspicious; may no one suffer sorrow.

devanagari: ॐ सह नाववतु । सह नौ भुनक्तु । सह वीर्यं करवावहै । तेजस्विनावधीतमस्तु मा विद्विषावहै । ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
phonetic: Om Saha Navavatu Saha Nau Bhunaktu Saha Viryam Karavavahai Tejasvinavadhitamastu Ma Vidvishavahai Om Shantih Shantih Shantih.
english_text: May we be protected and nourished together; may we work with strength; may our study be radiant; may we never hate one another.

devanagari: ॐ पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदं पूर्णात्पूर्णमुदच्यते । पूर्णस्य पूर्णमादाय पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते । ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
phonetic: Om Purnamadah Purnamidam Purnat Purnamudachyate Purnasya Purnamadaya Purnamevavashishyate Om Shantih Shantih Shantih.
english_text: That is whole; this is whole. From the Whole, the whole arises; when the whole is taken from the Whole, the Whole remains.

devanagari: त्वमेव माता च पिता त्वमेव । त्वमेव बन्धुश्च सखा त्वमेव । त्वमेव विद्या द्रविणं त्वमेव । त्वमेव सर्वं मम देव देव ॥
phonetic: Tvameva Mata Cha Pita Tvameva Tvameva Bandhushcha Sakha Tvameva Tvameva Vidya Dravinam Tvameva Tvameva Sarvam Mama Deva Deva.
english_text: You alone are my mother and father; You alone are my relative and friend. You alone are my knowledge, wealth, and everything.

devanagari: गुरुर्ब्रह्मा गुरुर्विष्णुः गुरुर्देवो महेश्वरः । गुरुः साक्षात् परब्रह्म तस्मै श्रीगुरवे नमः ॥
phonetic: Gurur Brahma Gurur Vishnuh Gurur Devo Maheshvarah Guruh Sakshat Parabrahma Tasmai Shri Gurave Namah.
english_text: The Guru is Brahma, Vishnu, and Maheshvara; the Guru is truly the Supreme Reality. Salutations to that revered Guru.

devanagari: शान्ताकारं भुजगशयनं पद्मनाभं सुरेशं विश्वाधारं गगनसदृशं मेघवर्णं शुभाङ्गम् । लक्ष्मीकान्तं कमलनयनं योगिभिर्ध्यानगम्यं वन्दे विष्णुं भवभयहरं सर्वलोकैकनाथम् ॥
phonetic: Shantakaram Bhujagashayanam Padmanabham Suresham Vishvadharam Gaganasadrisham Meghavarnam Shubhangam Lakshmikantam Kamalanayanam Yogibhir Dhyanagamyam Vande Vishnum Bhavabhayaharam Sarvalokaikanatham.
english_text: I bow to Vishnu, serene and reclining upon the serpent, the support of the universe, lotus-eyed and beloved of Lakshmi, who removes worldly fear.

devanagari: मङ्गलं भगवान् विष्णुः मङ्गलं गरुडध्वजः । मङ्गलं पुण्डरीकाक्षः मङ्गलायतनो हरिः ॥
phonetic: Mangalam Bhagavan Vishnuh Mangalam Garudadhvajah Mangalam Pundarikakshah Mangalayatanam Harih.
english_text: May auspiciousness come from Lord Vishnu, the bearer of Garuda's emblem, the lotus-eyed Lord, the abode and source of all auspiciousness.

devanagari: मनोजवं मारुततुल्यवेगं जितेन्द्रियं बुद्धिमतां वरिष्ठम् । वातात्मजं वानरयूथमुख्यं श्रीरामदूतं शरणं प्रपद्ये ॥
phonetic: Manojavam Marutatulyavegam Jitendriyam Buddhimatam Varishtham Vatatmajam Vanarayuthamukhyam Shri Ramadutam Sharanam Prapadye.
english_text: I seek refuge in Hanuman, swift as the mind and wind, master of the senses, foremost among the wise, son of the Wind, and servant of Rama.

devanagari: बुद्धिर्बलं यशो धैर्यं निर्भयत्वमरोगता । अजाड्यं वाक्पटुत्वं च हनूमत्स्मरणाद्भवेत् ॥
phonetic: Buddhir Balam Yasho Dhairyam Nirbhayatvam Arogata Ajadyam Vakpatutvam Cha Hanumat Smaranad Bhavet.
english_text: May remembrance of Hanuman grant wisdom, strength, fame, courage, fearlessness, health, alertness, and eloquent speech.

devanagari: ॐ द्यौः शान्तिरन्तरिक्षं शान्तिः पृथिवी शान्तिरापः । शान्तिरोषधयः शान्तिर्वनस्पतयः शान्तिर्विश्वेदेवाः शान्तिर्ब्रह्म शान्तिः सर्वं शान्तिः ॥
phonetic: Om Dyauh Shantir Antariksham Shantih Prithivi Shantir Apah Shantir Oshadhayah Shantir Vanaspatayah Shantir Vishvedevah Shantir Brahma Shantih Sarvam Shantih.
english_text: May there be peace in heaven, the atmosphere, the earth, the waters, the herbs, the trees, the gods, Brahman, and in all things.

devanagari: नमस्तेऽस्तु महामाये श्रीपीठे सुरपूजिते । शङ्खचक्रगदाहस्ते महालक्ष्मि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
phonetic: Namastestu Mahamaye Shri Pithe Surapujite Shankha Chakragadahaste Mahalakshmi Namostute.
english_text: Salutations to Mahalakshmi, the great Goddess, worshipped by the gods, bearing the conch, discus, and mace. I bow to You.

devanagari: सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके । शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
phonetic: Sarva Mangala Mangalye Shive Sarvartha Sadhike Sharanye Tryambake Gauri Narayani Namostute.
english_text: O auspicious One, beneficent Shiva, accomplisher of every aim, refuge, three-eyed Gauri, Narayani, I bow to You.

devanagari: कराग्रे वसते लक्ष्मीः करमध्ये सरस्वती । करमूले तु गोविन्दः प्रभाते करदर्शनम् ॥
phonetic: Karagre Vasate Lakshmih Karamadhye Sarasvati Karamule Tu Govindah Prabhate Karadarshanam.
english_text: At the fingertips dwells Lakshmi, in the middle of the hand Saraswati, and at its base Govinda; therefore I behold my hands in the morning.

devanagari: समुद्रवसने देवि पर्वतस्तनमण्डले । विष्णुपत्नि नमस्तुभ्यं पादस्पर्शं क्षमस्व मे ॥
phonetic: Samudravasane Devi Parvatastanamandale Vishnupatni Namastubhyam Padasparsham Kshamasva Me.
english_text: O Goddess Earth, clothed by the oceans and with mountains as Your breasts, consort of Vishnu, forgive my touching You with my feet.

devanagari: वसुदेवसुतं देवं कंसचाणूरमर्दनम् । देवकीपरमानन्दं कृष्णं वन्दे जगद्गुरुम् ॥
phonetic: Vasudevasutam Devam Kamsachanuramardanam Devakiparamanandam Krishnam Vande Jagadgurum.
english_text: I bow to Krishna, son of Vasudeva, destroyer of Kamsa and Chanura, joy of Devaki, and teacher of the world.

devanagari: कर्पूरगौरं करुणावतारं संसारसारं भुजगेन्द्रहारम् । सदा वसन्तं हृदयारविन्दे भवं भवानीसहितं नमामि ॥
phonetic: Karpuragauram Karunavataram Samsarasaram Bhujagendraharaṃ Sada Vasantam Hridayaravinde Bhavam Bhavanisahitam Namami.
english_text: I bow to Shiva with Bhavani, white as camphor, an embodiment of compassion, essence of existence, wearing the king of serpents as a garland.

devanagari: नागेन्द्रहाराय त्रिलोचनाय भस्माङ्गरागाय महेश्वराय । नित्याय शुद्धाय दिगम्बराय तस्मै नकाराय नमः शिवाय ॥
phonetic: Nagendrahārāya Trilochanaya Bhasmangaragay Maheshvaraya Nityaya Shuddhaya Digambaraya Tasmai Nakaraya Namah Shivaya.
english_text: Salutations to Shiva, three-eyed, adorned with the serpent king, smeared with sacred ash, eternal, pure, and unclad in the directions; salutations to the syllable Na.

devanagari: गजाननं भूतगणादिसेवितं कपित्थजम्बूफलचारुभक्षणम् । उमासुतं शोकविनाशकारणं नमामि विघ्नेश्वरपादपङ्कजम् ॥
phonetic: Gajananam Bhutaganadisevitam Kapitthajambuphalacharubhaksanam Umasutam Shokavinashakaranam Namami Vighneshvarapadapankajam.
english_text: I bow to Ganesha, elephant-faced and worshipped by hosts of beings, fond of kapittha and jambu fruits, son of Uma, and remover of sorrow.

devanagari: ॐ गं गणपतये नमः । ॐ गं गणपतये नमः । ॐ गं गणपतये नमः ॥
phonetic: Om Gam Ganapataye Namah Om Gam Ganapataye Namah Om Gam Ganapataye Namah.
english_text: Salutations to Lord Ganapati, the remover of obstacles. This sacred seed mantra is traditionally repeated in worship of Ganesha.

devanagari: कायेन वाचा मनसेन्द्रियैर्वा बुद्ध्यात्मना वा प्रकृतेः स्वभावात् । करोमि यद्यत् सकलं परस्मै नारायणायेति समर्पयामि ॥
phonetic: Kayena Vacha Manasendriyairva Buddhyatmana Va Prakriteh Svabhavat Karomi Yadyat Sakalam Parasmai Narayanayeti Samarpayami.
english_text: Whatever I do with body, speech, mind, senses, intellect, or by my nature, I offer entirely to the Supreme, Narayana.

devanagari: ॐ भद्रं कर्णेभिः शृणुयाम देवाः । भद्रं पश्येमाक्षभिर्यजत्राः । स्थिरैरङ्गैस्तुष्टुवांसस्तनूभिर्व्यशेम देवहितं यदायुः । ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः ॥
phonetic: Om Bhadram Karnebhih Shrinuyama Devah Bhadram Pashyemakshabhir Yajatrah Sthirair Angais Tushtuvamsas Tanubhir Vyashema Devahitam Yadayuh Om Shantih Shantih Shantih.
english_text: May we hear what is auspicious, see what is auspicious, and live out our allotted years with healthy limbs, praising the Divine.

devanagari: जयन्ती मङ्गला काली भद्रकाली कपालिनी । दुर्गा क्षमा शिवा धात्री स्वाहा स्वधा नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
phonetic: Jayanti Mangala Kali Bhadrakali Kapalini Durga Kshama Shiva Dhatri Svaha Svadha Namostute.
english_text: Salutations to the Divine Mother known as Jayanti, Mangala, Kali, Bhadrakali, Kapalini, Durga, Kshama, Shiva, Dhatri, Svaha, and Svadha.

devanagari: ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय । ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय । ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय ॥
phonetic: Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya.
english_text: Salutations to the Blessed Lord Vasudeva. This revered twelve-syllable mantra expresses surrender and devotion to Krishna.

devanagari: ॐ श्री हनुमते नमः । ॐ श्री हनुमते नमः । ॐ श्री हनुमते नमः ॥
phonetic: Om Shri Hanumate Namah Om Shri Hanumate Namah Om Shri Hanumate Namah.
english_text: Salutations to Shri Hanuman. This traditional mantra invokes his strength, devotion, courage, and protection.

devanagari: ॐ नमो नारायणाय । ॐ नमो नारायणाय । ॐ नमो नारायणाय ॥
phonetic: Om Namo Narayanaya Om Namo Narayanaya Om Namo Narayanaya.
english_text: Salutations to Lord Narayana. This traditional eight-syllable mantra expresses reverence and surrender to Vishnu.

devanagari: शुक्लाम्बरधरं विष्णुं शशिवर्णं चतुर्भुजम् । प्रसन्नवदनं ध्यायेत् सर्वविघ्नोपशान्तये ॥
phonetic: Shuklambaradharam Vishnum Shashivarnam Chaturbhujam Prasannavadanam Dhyayet Sarvavighnopashantaye.
english_text: We meditate on Vishnu, clad in white, moon-bright, four-armed, and serene-faced, for the pacification of all obstacles.

devanagari: रामाय रामभद्राय रामचन्द्राय वेधसे । रघुनाथाय नाथाय सीतायाः पतये नमः ॥
phonetic: Ramaya Ramabhadraya Ramachandraya Vedhase Raghunathaya Nathaya Sitayah Pataye Namah.
english_text: Salutations to Rama, Rama the gracious, Rama Chandra, Lord of the Raghu lineage, protector, and husband of Sita.

devanagari: हरे राम हरे राम राम राम हरे हरे । हरे कृष्ण हरे कृष्ण कृष्ण कृष्ण हरे हरे ॥
phonetic: Hare Rama Hare Rama Rama Rama Hare Hare Hare Krishna Hare Krishna Krishna Krishna Hare Hare.
english_text: Chanting the holy names of Rama and Krishna is a traditional devotional practice, calling upon the Divine through these sacred names.

devanagari: श्रीराम जय राम जय जय राम । श्रीराम जय राम जय जय राम । श्रीराम जय राम जय जय राम ॥
phonetic: Shri Rama Jaya Rama Jaya Jaya Rama Shri Rama Jaya Rama Jaya Jaya Rama Shri Rama Jaya Rama Jaya Jaya Rama.
english_text: Victory to Lord Rama. Repeating His sacred name is a traditional practice of devotion and remembrance.

devanagari: ॐ ऐं सरस्वत्यै नमः । ॐ ऐं सरस्वत्यै नमः । ॐ ऐं सरस्वत्यै नमः ॥
phonetic: Om Aim Saraswatyai Namah Om Aim Saraswatyai Namah Om Aim Saraswatyai Namah.
english_text: Salutations to Goddess Saraswati through Her seed mantra, traditionally invoked for learning, knowledge, speech, and wisdom.

devanagari: ॐ महालक्ष्म्यै च विद्महे विष्णुपत्न्यै च धीमहि तन्नो लक्ष्मीः प्रचोदयात् । ॐ श्रीं महालक्ष्म्यै नमः ॥
phonetic: Om Mahalakshmyai Cha Vidmahe Vishnupatnyai Cha Dhimahi Tanno Lakshmih Prachodayat Om Shrim Mahalakshmyai Namah.
english_text: We meditate upon Mahalakshmi, consort of Vishnu. May Lakshmi inspire us, and may we honor Her with devotion and gratitude for abundance.

devanagari: ॐ तत्पुरुषाय विद्महे महादेवाय धीमहि तन्नो रुद्रः प्रचोदयात् । ॐ नमः शिवाय ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥
phonetic: Om Tatpurushaya Vidmahe Mahadevaya Dhimahi Tanno Rudrah Prachodayat Om Namah Shivaya Om Namah Shivaya.
english_text: We meditate upon Mahadeva and invoke Rudra to inspire us. Om Namah Shivaya is a traditional sacred mantra expressing reverence to Lord Shiva.

devanagari: ॐ एकदन्ताय विद्महे वक्रतुण्डाय धीमहि तन्नो दन्तिः प्रचोदयात् । ॐ गं गणपतये नमः ॐ गं गणपतये नमः ॥
phonetic: Om Ekadantaya Vidmahe Vakratundaya Dhimahi Tanno Dantih Prachodayat Om Gam Ganapataye Namah Om Gam Ganapataye Namah.
english_text: We meditate upon the One-Tusked, curved-trunked Lord Ganesha. May He inspire us; His sacred Ganapati mantra is traditionally repeated in devotion.

devanagari: ॐ आञ्जनेयाय विद्महे वायुपुत्राय धीमहि तन्नो हनुमत् प्रचोदयात् । ॐ श्री हनुमते नमः ॐ श्री हनुमते नमः ॥
phonetic: Om Anjaneyaya Vidmahe Vayuputraya Dhimahi Tanno Hanumat Prachodayat Om Shri Hanumate Namah Om Shri Hanumate Namah.
english_text: We meditate upon Hanuman, son of Anjana and the Wind. May Hanuman inspire us; the sacred Hanuman mantra is traditionally invoked for courage and devotion.

devanagari: ॐ नमः शिवाय । ॐ नमः शिवाय । ॐ नमः शिवाय । ॐ नमः शिवाय । ॐ नमः शिवाय । ॐ नमः शिवाय । ॐ नमः शिवाय ॥
phonetic: Om Namah Shivaya Om Namah Shivaya Om Namah Shivaya Om Namah Shivaya Om Namah Shivaya Om Namah Shivaya Om Namah Shivaya.
english_text: Salutations to Shiva. Om Namah Shivaya is the revered five-syllable mantra of Shiva, traditionally repeated as an expression of devotion and remembrance.
